metadata.description: Anthovai — the AI platforms, enterprise software, and intelligent infrastructure company. Built from Thailand, for the world.

hero.eyebrow: A HOUSE OF KAISER KLOWNS · IT / SOFTWARE / AI
hero.body: We build the AI platforms, enterprise software, and intelligent infrastructure that power organizations forward. From Thailand, for the world.

about.label: WHO WE ARE
about.headline: The backbone of bold organizations.
about.p1: Anthovai was founded with a single conviction: that the right technology, built with intelligence and intention, can transform any organization.
about.p2: From AI-driven automation to enterprise resource management, from cloud infrastructure to bespoke B2B platforms — we build the systems that make organizations work better, faster, and smarter.
about.p3: We don't just deliver software. We architect legacies.

arkai.name: Arkai
arkai.desc: Intelligent automation for teams. Capture, summarize, and act on information without switching tools. Built for organizations that cannot afford to slow down.

aello.name: Aello
aello.desc: An integrated development environment built with AI at its core. Write, test, and deploy faster — with intelligence woven into every stage.

alfa.name: Alfa
alfa.desc: A comprehensive enterprise resource management system designed for organizations that demand precision, reliability, and scalability.

klownsnexus.name: KlownsNexus
klownsnexus.desc: A complete business operations suite — office tools, project management, and collaboration in one unified platform.

klang.headline: Klang — One Language. Every Platform.
klang.sub: A modern, statically-typed, compiled language with the speed of C, readability of Python, and built-in AI primitives. The foundation of the Anthovai ecosystem.

ambition.title: Ambition

klang_page.hero_headline: The Language We Built to Power Everything.
klang_page.hero_body: Klang is a modern, statically-typed, compiled programming language — designed for performance, readability, and AI-native capabilities.

speed.title: Speed
speed.desc: Compiles to native binaries. Zero-cost abstractions. C-level performance without the complexity.

readability.title: Readability
readability.desc: Clean, Python-inspired syntax that's easy to write, easy to read, and easy to maintain.

structure.title: Structure
structure.desc: First-class structs, traits, and modules. Type safety without ceremony.

ai.title: AI-Native
ai.desc: Built-in AI primitives — model, infer, train — as language keywords, not libraries.

native.title: Native Binary
native.desc: Direct machine code compilation for maximum performance.

llvm.title: LLVM IR
llvm.desc: Full LLVM backend for cross-platform optimization.

wasm.title: WebAssembly
wasm.desc: Run Klang in any browser or edge runtime.

klang.name: Klang
klang.desc: The language itself — compiler, stdlib, and toolchain.

rumba.name: DevStudio Rumba
rumba.desc: The official Klang IDE and development environment.

arkai.name: Arkai AI
arkai.desc: AI platform built with Klang at its core.

ocean.name: Ocean OS
ocean.desc: Operating system kernel components written in Klang.
